Name: Energy Rework
Author: seferonipepperoni
Description:
[center]﻿[/center][color=#d8d8d8][size=6][b]Overview[/b][/size][/color] ﻿
﻿
[size=4]This mod intends to be a highly scope-limited and lightweight implementation of a persistent energy drain system. The intent is to ensure that energy management remains a non-trivial endeavour throughout the game, and to make the threat of exhaustion significantly more pressing.

In its current state (v1.1.0), Energy Rework does the following things:
﻿
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]Drains a configurable amount of stamina every ten (in-game) minutes, [b]more if the player is running.[/b] By default, this passive drain [b]can never drive the player towards exhaustion or force them to pass out[/b], and is disabled during festivals, while sitting, while in the spa, and whenever time is paused.[/size]
[/list] ﻿[list]
[*][size=4]Recovers a configurable amount of energy when the player is seated every ten (in-game) minutes.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Vanilla sources of energy loss are not modified.
[/b][/size] ﻿
[color=#d8d8d8][size=6][b]Configuration[/b][/size][/color]
﻿
[size=4]This mod has integrated [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url]support. Options include:
﻿
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]the base energy loss value, deducted every ten minutes if conditions (listed above) obtain,[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4]the energy floor, beyond which passive Energy drain can no longer occur,[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4]the energy loss while moving,[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4]the energy gained while sitting,[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4]and the ceiling beyond which seated Energy gain can no longer occur.[/size]
[/list]
[color=#d8d8d8][size=6][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
﻿[size=4][center][/center][/size][size=4]Unzip the archive into Stardew Valley\Mods.
[/size]
[color=#d8d8d8][size=6][b]Dependencies[/b][/size][/color][size=4][b]

This mod requires SMAPI v4.0.0 (and newer). [/b]Older versions may work, but are unsupported.[/size][b]

[color=#d8d8d8][size=6]Known Issues[/size][/color][/b]
[size=4]
There are no issues being tracked as of version 1.1.0. Please report bugs in the Bugs section along with your log file ([url=https://smapi.io/log]use this for sharing.[/url])[/size][b][size=5]

[/size][/b][color=#d8d8d8][size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]

[size=4]There are no compatibility issues being tracked as of version 1.1.0.
[b]
Compatibility issues will likely arise with mods that modify the game's timescale[/b], and with mods that similarly attempt to handle passive energy loss.[/size][size=4]
